headword: {総額表示|そうがくひょうじ}
gloss: tax-inclusive price display; displaying the total price

definitions.gloss: tax-inclusive price display; showing the final all-inclusive total on price tags and advertisements
definitions.explanation: The practice of displaying the full, tax-included price on price tags, menus, and advertisements — rather than the pre-tax price. Under Japan's Consumer Tax Act, businesses selling to consumers are required to use {総額表示|そうがくひょうじ} so that the shopper can see at a glance what they will actually pay.

examples.japanese: {総額表示|そうがくひょうじ}が{義務|ぎむ}だ。
このお{店|みせ}は{総額表示|そうがくひょうじ}になっている。
examples.english: This shop uses tax-inclusive price displays.

examples.japanese: {2021年|にせんにじゅういちねん}から{総額表示|そうがくひょうじ}が{完全義務化|かんぜんぎむか}された。
examples.english: Tax-inclusive pricing became fully mandatory in 2021.

examples.japanese: {総額表示|そうがくひょうじ}なら、レジで{実際|じっさい}に{払|はら}う{金額|きんがく}が{一目|ひとめ}でわかる。
examples.english: With tax-inclusive pricing, you can tell at a glance how much you'll actually pay at the register.

notes:
Composed of {総額|そうがく} (total amount) and {表示|ひょうじ} (display, indication).

USAGE:
This is a retail and consumer-law term that most shoppers in Japan have seen on posters and receipts. The contrast is with {税抜|ぜいぬき} pricing, where only the pre-tax amount is shown and consumption tax is added at checkout. Under the revised Consumer Tax Act, retailers selling to end consumers must show the tax-inclusive total — though they may also show the pre-tax price alongside.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {総額表示|そうがくひょうじ}が{義務|ぎむ}: tax-inclusive pricing is mandatory
- {総額表示|そうがくひょうじ}{義務化|ぎむか}: making tax-inclusive pricing mandatory
- {総額表示|そうがくひょうじ}に{対応|たいおう}する: to switch over to tax-inclusive pricing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {税込|ぜいこみ}: tax included — the short tag placed on prices to indicate they already include tax
- {税抜|ぜいぬき}: tax excluded — the opposite; a label or pricing style showing the pre-tax amount only
- {本体価格|ほんたいかかく}: base price — the pre-tax price of an item, often shown in smaller print next to the total
